notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: one Forest Lookouts page with a legal location and two quoted 1938 and 1940 Choteau Acantha notices. No build date, design, height or current status in any source read. Search turned up Monument Peak (Meagher County, a different lookout) and nothing for Moonlight Peak. Not on the FFLA standing list, which is a list of standing towers, so that absence does not prove the site is gone. The 1938 and 1940 notices name individuals; the story omits them. Record kind and status remain unknown. The story is under 120 words because the sources are that thin.
